summary.en: BenchCouncil AI100 (2022-2023) annual entry in Multimodal

description.en:
BenchCouncil lists OFA in the Multimodal area of its AI100 (2022-2023) annual table. It associates the work with the publication “OFA: Unifying Architectures, Tasks, and Modalities Through a Simple Sequence-to-Sequence Learning Framework”. The page names Peng Wang, Chang Zhou as the main contributors.

This Archive record preserves the official row order, citation value, institution, and country fields. It represents the annual 2022-2023 selection and remains separate from the long-term canonical AI100 storyline.
